title: Concept mappings
unavailable.title: Concept mappings are not available here
choose.title: Choose two courses
choose.body: Link objectives of two different courses as equivalent, overlapping, or one a prerequisite of the other. Only an owner or admin of both courses can save a mapping, and every save is kept as a version with who saved it. Nothing is inferred automatically.
choose.empty.title: Two published courses are needed
choose.empty.body: You can map courses where you are an owner or admin.
choose.sameCourse: Both choices are versions of the same course. Choose two different courses.
retired: Mapping retired as version {version, number}. Pending learner suggestions from it were withdrawn.
links.title: Links between objectives
links.heading: {first} and {second}
links.body: Learners decide, for each pair of their own courses, whether anything is shared. Suggestions made from a mapping never grant mastery or pass a checkpoint: each course still decides from its own checks.
links.empty: No links yet. Add the first one.
noteHint: Who reviewed the mapping, or why it changed. Shown to staff only.
incomplete: Choose an objective on both sides of every link before saving.
